nodes.text:
@glynhuskisson1 @wesstreeting @strawfie @cv_cev Just done a Google search. You can get PCR tests which test for multiple viruses. They are expensive

So sorry you've been infected unnecessarily. I hope you can rest and feel better soon. I'm sure you don't need me to tell you to try and drink lots of suitable fluids.
